chapter: Boston, Berklee and New York encounters
title: Roy Haynes and the end of the first day
summary: Haynes backed Sarah Vaughan and was voted best dressed; Brown closes the first session.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: And you also had a chance to play with Roy Haynes, or sit in with Roy Haynes?
Oh, Roy didn‟t have a group.
Yeah, that‟s what I suspect, so….
He was working with Sarah Vaughan. He was playing, backing for Sarah Vaughan those days, so…. But he was voted [one of the] ten best-dressed men by Esquire!
Still is! [chuckles] Okay, well, I think probably this is a good time to stop….
… and we can move on after your Berklee experience. But we want to pick up
with talking about Hickory House, how you got those engagements, and now you start your real career [laughs].
